lines.welcome: Welcome to the light table. Each block here is a part of your product.
lines.open-wing: Tap a wing to open it.
lines.step-in: Tap it once more, to step inside.
lines.decide: Each card is one decision. Approve it, or decline.
lines.decide-noted: Noted. On this sample, nothing is sent.
lines.back: BACK takes you out, one step at a time.
lines.menu: Everything else is in the menu. Tap MENU.
lines.menu-open: Rooms, scans, your morning, settings, and this tour.
lines.standup: Every morning starts here. Approve this one, or leave it for later.
lines.standup-how: Pinch APPROVE or LATER on the card, or press A twice.
lines.standup-none: Nothing waits this morning. The stand-up lives in the menu.
lines.talk: And you can simply ask me. Hold me, or hold TALK on your wrist.
lines.hand-off: That's the table. It's yours. The tour and its chapters are in the menu.
lines.hands-pull: Pinch a wing and pull it toward you. It opens, like a tap.
lines.hands-push: Push away to go back out. It works like BACK.
lines.hands-wrist: Your wrist holds quick decisions. On a controller, A taps and B goes back.
lines.scan-arm: Tap SCAN once to arm it, then again to start.
lines.scan-watch: Each room lights up as it is read. The findings land below.
lines.morning-decide: Each card is one decision. Approve it, or leave it for later.
lines.morning-plan: Then PLAN MY DAY asks the companion what today's work should be.
lines.morning-hand: HAND OVER lets the companion work for today. TAKE BACK ends it.
lines.room-switch: Tap the room switch on the bar. Your own room appears around the table.
lines.room-back: Tap it again, and the studio comes back.
lines.talk-hold: Hold me, or hold TALK on your wrist, and speak. Let go to send.
lines.talk-where: Your words go to your PC, then a speech service. Nothing is kept.
lines.talk-choice: It stays off until you allow it. SETTINGS, under TALK, changes it.
lines.text-size: Tap 130 percent, and every word grows: the menu, the wrist, my captions.
lines.text-more: Reduced motion, captions and your wrist's hand are here too.
lines.pc-what: Linked to your PC, the table shows your own projects and live scans.
lines.pc-sample: This headset shows a sample. Linked to your PC, it shows your projects.
lines.pc-pair: PAIR shows a code. Approve it on your PC, and your answers go there.
